title: Modernising a Security Integration Platform to Accelerate Automation
summary: A large enterprise customer needed to modernise a legacy integration platform responsible for synchronising security and engineering workflow data across multiple systems. We redesigned the architecture using a modular approach, dramatically improving maintainability, scalability, and performance while enabling the customer to meet a critical go-live deadline.
problem:
The customer relied on a custom integration platform to automate ticket creation and synchronisation between engineering workflow tools and IT service management systems. They needed to extend the platform to support a new target system while also replacing a critical internal API that was being decommissioned.

The existing third-party implementation had accumulated significant technical debt and lacked the flexibility needed to support future business requirements. At the same time, the project faced a tight delivery timeline ahead of a critical go-live date.
solution:
We redesigned the solution architecture using a modular Python-based structure with clear separation of concerns, improving maintainability, extensibility, and consistency across the platform.

Introducing system-specific parallelisation and intelligent caching layers to improve performance, while also modernising dependency management and upgrading outdated libraries.

Automated testing and improved engineering standards were implemented to increase code quality, reduce delivery risk, and provide a reliable foundation for future development.
outcome:
The customer successfully achieved their target go-live date and now has a scalable and maintainable integration platform capable of supporting future systems and evolving business requirements.

Performance improvements reduced processing times from more than four hours to just minutes, significantly improving operational efficiency. The project also enabled the decommissioning of legacy infrastructure dependencies, reducing platform complexity and ongoing maintenance overhead.
